title.narrative: UNDP Technical Assistance to the Final Beneficiaries of the EIB-funded Ukraine Recovery Programmes

description.narrative: The UNDP Technical Assistance for the Ukraine Recovery Programme (URP and URP-III) is a 24-month initiative (January 2026–December 2027) funded by the European Investment Bank (EUR 6 million). It is designed to ensure that EIB-financed recovery investments in Ukraine are delivered efficiently and transparently.
